says: A plant's record line holds no time it ran and no commit, so an --out record from a run outside the workflow keeps neither; AGENTS.md's data-shape rule asks for the writer's own time when it is written.
proof: Each of runs/plants/*.json from the build holds only the keys plant, target, law, answer, beside, tests, seconds, stryker and node (for example host-pin.json); the Line interface at Report.ts:160-170 has no time or commit field.
cost: The time of a local or box plant run survives only if a run row copies it by hand; records from different heads cannot be told apart.
